Cookies

We use cookies and personal data to analyse the use of the website and for personalised advertising with your consent. This includes but is not limited to King's Head Theatre marketing and third party advertising.

Functional cookies

These are necessary for the website to function properly. This way your basket will be remembered and you can log in on the website with your account.

Minimal cookies

This option allows cookies to enrich your experience on the website. For example, media from third parties such as videos. We also keep statistics to continuously improve the site.

All cookies

With these cookies we collect personal data to carry out our marketing activities, such as newsletters and ad personalisations.

Read our full Privacy & Cookies Policy.
